## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? -->

## PR title

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`type: description`, `type(scope): description`, or `type!: description` for breaking changes) — it drives both the auto-label and the eventual version bump.

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `style`
- [ ] `test` / `ci` / `build` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in the title / `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## Test plan

<!-- How did you verify this? e.g. `npm test`, manual run against a real PR, etc. -->

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` run and `dist/index.js` committed (if `index.js` changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `develop` (not `main`), unless this is a release PR or hotfix
